currentTaskDescription: Enhancement #16: Asset graph traversal API - Add GET /assets/{assetId}/subgraph?maxDepth=3&assetTypes=Subdomain,Url to AssetService. PostgreSQL recursive CTE via Dapper: WITH RECURSIVE reachable AS (SELECT to_asset_id FROM asset_relationships WHERE from_asset_id = rootId UNION ALL SELECT r.to_asset_id FROM asset_relationships r JOIN reachable ON r.from_asset_id = reachable.to_asset_id) SELECT * FROM assets WHERE asset_id IN (SELECT to_asset_id FROM reachable). MaxDepth and assetTypes params. File: src/Services/Argus.AssetService/
context: Added Dapper ref to csproj. Added GetSubgraphAsync to IAssetStore. Implemented BFS in InMemoryAssetStore and PostgreSQL recursive CTE via Dapper in EfAssetStore. Added GET /assets/{assetId}/subgraph?maxDepth&assetTypes endpoint. Build env unavailable but code follows existing patterns.
